notes: Instacart's San Francisco stores, from the list typed into issue #281 on 2026-09-12. **The directory was not fetched.** https://www.instacart.com/robots.txt ends in `User-Agent: *` / `Disallow: /`, a blanket disallow, and this repo honours robots.txt in every module — so the fifty-four listings here are the ones the issue's author transcribed from https://www.instacart.com/grocery-delivery/ca/near-me-in-san-francisco-ca, and every entry carries a name and an address and nothing else. No categories and no opening hours: a transcribed list has none, so no entry publishes `kinds` or `opening_hours` and no panel carries a "Last updated" line. A refresh means asking a human for a fresh list, not re-running a fetch. The one page that was opened is the referral credential itself, which merchants/AGENTS.md requires be read rather than taken from the ticket: https://www.instacart.com/?code=SROSENTHAL1F3D5 carries a share-code payload whose landing modal reads "You got $10 referral credit!" over "$10 off" and "Savings applied at checkout", which agrees with the issue's "$10 / $10". One offer covers the whole directory, so there is one REFERRALS row, `instacart`, and one source id on every page; the link opens the home page rather than the shop, so the row carries a `note` telling the reader to sign up and then shop the store, the way HotelTonight's does. Four listings are Instacart's own rapid-delivery tiers of shops already in the list — Safeway Rapid, Andronico's Rapid, FoodsCo Delivery Now and Target: Fast Delivery, each filed at its twin's address with a synthetic "Suite A20" appended — and they are declined rather than published as second businesses at one door. Four addresses needed resolving by hand: 3995 Alemany Boulevard and 2815 Diamond Street, which EAS files on a retired parcel and on a flat; 789 Mission Street, which EAS holds with no parcel at all; and 465 Hayes Street, whose seven-parcel map the 2025 roll has yet to report, so its page was written by hand with no roll facts.
